source_units.text: Before a supervised bicycle workshop, I need to understand the drivetrain terminology.
Use the exact labels "Chain Wear", "Derailleur Indexing", "Cassette Inspection" in the schedule, with at least 15 total minutes assigned to each.
Within that coverage, "Chain Wear" needs at least 25 total minutes.
My priority is "Cassette Inspection": its cumulative study time must reach 30 minutes or more.
The last usable study date is 2027-02-07, and sessions may fall on that day.
